In detail

Avon and Somerset Constabulary recorded 53 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 3.1 per 1,000 residents, the 32nd highest rate of Bath's 33 wards. The daytime score here is driven by vehicle crime (1), burglary (1), drugs (0); the evening/night score by violent crime (8), anti social behaviour (2), public order (1). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Midsomer Norton North safe?

Wandroz currently rates Midsomer Norton North in Bath as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Bath during the day and relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Bath at night. This rating is derived from Avon and Somerset Constabulary street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Midsomer Norton North safe at night?

At night, Midsomer Norton North is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Bath. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.
